title: Ghost Ship Rumors
description: Three boats haven't come back to Dalhurst harbor since the mist ship started showing at dawn - the last one, the Merrow's Kiss, went out with two brothers aboard and neither's been seen since. The Harbor Master needs to know if he's looking at smugglers using a ghost story for cover, or something that actually took those men, before he loses a fourth boat to it.

objectives.description: Ask the fishermen what they saw before the boats stopped coming back
Search the western coastline for signs of the ghost ship
Examine the strange cargo from the wreck
Tell the Harbor Master what happened to the Merrow's Kiss

notes: Threat: two named brothers lost with the Merrow's Kiss, third boat missing overall (invented for this quest only, prose colour, no bible basis). Leads into harbor_ghost_ship - the lighthouse investigation follows directly from what's found here.
